title: LandstarOne® Mobile App Now for Third-Party Carriers
summary: LandstarOne® is the one-stop mobile app for independent owner-operators leased to Landstar and now it is also available to Landstar-approved third-party carriers.
body_markdown:
## Landstar-approved carriers now have access to thousands of load opportunities through the LandstarOne® mobile app.


### Download the LandstarOne® app to:


- Access thousands of load opportunities with Landstar Load Search
- Streamline the booking process with important load details including revenue, rate per mile, load dates and times, weight, miles, load age, and load comments available right in the app
- Find the best fuel prices, including[SavingsPlus®](https://www.landstaronline.com/Waam/SavingsPlus.asp) fuel discount details
- See your fuel price net of IFTA credit by location


#### Download LandstarOne® on the[App Store](https://apple.co/2XnHlk9) or on[Google Play.](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.landstar.one)


[Click here to onboard as a qualified carrier](https://onboard.dat.com/landstar)
